bio.summary: Neil D. McKay earned a Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering from the University of Michigan in 1985 (advisor Kang G. Shin), after a B.S. from the University of Rochester (1980) and an M.S. from Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute (1982). The thesis was on minimum-cost control of robotic manipulators with geometric path constraints.
